description: The Trust Framework the three reference policies read: the governance-engine domains the processor decides under (its PDP Domain Prefix, idpartners.authorization_details, then the type) and the request attributes GovernanceEngineRequestBuilder sends. Each attribute is resolved from the request; a dotted name is a path of parents, as the PDP reads the processor's <prefix>.<type>.<field> attributes.

attributes.name: principal_source
attributes.description: How the processor established the decision's subject: authenticated, identity_hint, subject_token, client or none

attributes.name: idp.payment_initiation.amount
attributes.description: The flat amount a payment_initiation detail requests, as the processor sends it with its default attribute prefix
